# M3-1a: Decision log and labelled history

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-1a`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-1a`
- Depends on: none
- Touches (exclusive while running): store/
- Plan refs: §2 `decisions`, §3.2 step 6, §3.3, BACKLOG "What the active plan means for M3"
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
The `decisions` table exists with accessors, and one query returns human-labelled transactions across plans. Calibration,
payee history and the rules layer all use that query, so what's measured is what runs.

## Scope
- Migration `0006_decisions.sql`: plan_id, txn_id, category_id (null when none chosen), category_name, confidence, runner_up,
  method (`rule`/`model`), model, policy_hash, candidates_hash, mode (`dry_run`/`auto`), outcome (`would_apply`, `applied`,
  `asked`, `skipped`), second_opinion (nullable JSON), features (JSON), created_at, superseded_by. Every key carries `plan_id`,
  because M4's Fresh Start brings new plan and txn ids.
- Accessors: insert (superseding the previous row for that txn in one transaction), latest decision for a txn, decision
  history for a txn, and "has a current decision for this txn + model + policy + candidates + mode".
- `LabeledHistory(ctx, planIDs, activeCategoryNames, excludedNames)`: rows from those plans with `approved=true`, a real category, not
  deleted, not a split parent or child, not a transfer. Rows are left out entirely when the category is internal, `Inflow: Ready to Assign`,
  in the `Credit Card Payments` group, or named in `excludedNames` (the set-asides from the policy file). Each remaining row has date, amount,
  normalized payee, memo, account name, category name, `in_active_list` (exact name match, case-insensitive), and source plan.
- Mirror reads for later tasks, which don't touch `store/`:
  - `CategoriesWithGroups(ctx, planID)`: every category with its group name, note, and hidden and deleted flags for both category and group. `Goals` only returns rows with a target, so it can't serve this.
  - `TransactionByID(ctx, planID, txnID)`: the full row, including category, approved, date, deleted, split and transfer state, plus account and payee names.
  - `EligibleTransactions(ctx, planID, since, limit)`: uncategorized or unapproved, not deleted, newest first, with payee, memo, account name, amount, date.
- De-duplicate rows copied across plans (same `import_id`, or same date + amount + normalized payee when it's null); keep the
  newest plan's row.

## Out of scope
- write_log, locks, questions (M3-1b, M3-1c). Any calibration math. Reading from YNAB.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: migration applies on a DB at 0005; store tests use a temp file.
- [ ] Test: a second decision supersedes the first; history returns both in order.
- [ ] Fixture test: LabeledHistory excludes unapproved, deleted, split and transfer rows.
- [ ] Fixture test: a category absent from the active list comes back with `in_active_list=false`, not dropped.
- [ ] Fixture test: a transaction copied across two plans comes back once, from the newest plan.
- [ ] Fixture test: approved Ready to Assign, Credit Card Payments and `excludedNames` rows don't come back at all.
- [ ] Fixture tests: `CategoriesWithGroups` includes hidden and deleted flags and categories with no target; `TransactionByID` found and not found; `EligibleTransactions` honours `since`, `limit` and order and leaves out deleted rows.
- [ ] Test: a decision made in `dry_run` is not current when asked for `auto`.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `store/migrations/0006_decisions.sql`: `decisions`, primary key `(plan_id, id)`, composite FK on `superseded_by`, partial unique index allowing one current row per txn, CHECKs on method, mode, outcome and JSON.
  - `store/decisions.go`: `InsertDecision`, `LatestDecision`, `DecisionHistory`, `HasCurrentDecision(ctx, plan, txn, DecisionKey)`.
  - `store/labeled_read.go`: `LabeledHistory`, `LabeledRow`, `NormalizePayee` (exported for M3-1c and M3-2).
  - `store/mirror_read.go`: `CategoriesWithGroups`, `TransactionByID`, `EligibleTransactions`; the last two return `TransactionDetail`.
  - `store/store_test.go`: migration counts bumped for 0006.
- Acceptance:
  - Migration applies on a DB at 0005: pass, `go test ./store -run TestMigration0006OnExisting0005DB`.
  - Second decision supersedes the first, history returns both in order: pass, `-run TestInsertDecisionSupersedesAndKeepsHistory`.
  - LabeledHistory excludes unapproved, deleted, split and transfer rows: pass, `-run TestLabeledHistoryExcludesUnlabelledRows`.
  - Absent category comes back `in_active_list=false`: pass, `-run TestLabeledHistoryAbsentCategoryIsKeptAndFlagged`.
  - Copy across two plans comes back once, from the newest: pass, `-run TestLabeledHistoryDedupesAcrossPlans`.
  - Ready to Assign, Credit Card Payments and `excludedNames` left out: pass, `-run 'TestLabeledHistoryDrops'`.
  - `CategoriesWithGroups`, `TransactionByID`, `EligibleTransactions`: pass, `-run 'TestCategoriesWithGroups|TestTransactionByID|TestEligibleTransactions'`.
  - `dry_run` decision not current for `auto`: pass, `-run TestHasCurrentDecision`.
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...`: pass.
- Deviations from brief (choices where the brief was silent):
  - "Newest plan" is the plan with the latest live transaction date, because the mirror stores no plan creation date. Ties keep the order of `planIDs`, so pass the active plan first.
  - De-duplication runs after filtering, so an older plan's label survives when the newer copy is unapproved or deleted.
  - A row with an `import_id` also matches a newer row that has none, on date + amount + normalized payee. Two different non-null `import_id`s never match. Look-alikes within one plan are all kept.
  - The Credit Card Payments check also uses `original_category_group_id`, so a hidden card category stays excluded.
  - `category_name`, `confidence` and `runner_up` are nullable as well as `category_id`, since a skip has none. `model`, `policy_hash` and `candidates_hash` are NOT NULL and store `''` when absent.
  - `EligibleTransactions` also treats YNAB's internal `Uncategorized` category as uncategorized; `since` is `YYYY-MM-DD`; `limit <= 0` means no limit.
  - `NormalizePayee` had no prior definition: lower case, apostrophes removed, other non-alphanumeric runs become one space.
- Follow-ups for backlog:
  - `method` is NOT NULL and only `rule` or `model`, as briefed. A guardrail skip has neither, so M3-11 must pick one or not log those rows, or `decisions` needs a third method.
  - `LabeledRow` has exactly the briefed fields: no transaction id and only the normalized payee. If M3-5 needs to exclude a row from its own payee history by id, or to feed the model raw payee names as runtime does, it needs those two fields added in `store/`.
  - `import_id` matching follows the brief and ignores account. YNAB-format ids encode only amount, date and occurrence, so same-day, same-amount imports on different accounts in different plans can collapse to one row. Rare; costs one label.
- Docs follow-ups: CLAUDE.md `store/` entry: add `0006_decisions` to the migration list, and mention `store/decisions.go`, `store/labeled_read.go` and `store/mirror_read.go`.
